primary_sources.source_name: RBI Annual Report — Scheduled Commercial Banks Statistical Tables
primary_sources.notes: Indian scheduled commercial bank cost-to-income ratio range: 40–55% (FY2024).
Operating expenses ~₹58,000 Cr on total income ~₹2,40,000 Cr. IT and digital spend disclosed in notes.
Employee expenses and technology spend as % of operating revenue from annual report segment notes.

primary_sources.source_name: State Bank of India FY25 Annual Report (BSE: 500112)
primary_sources.notes: Employee benefit expense ~55% of total opex; technology spend disclosed in management discussion.
KYC/AML automation adoption, core banking modernisation, and digital channel cost benchmarks.

source_metadata.methodology: Generic spend categories (IT, travel, marketing, etc.) expressed as % of revenue from BSE annual reports. BFSI-specific and workforce categories expressed as % of total opex, consistent with RBI statistical tables and bank disclosure formats. Percentiles derived from 10 listed peer banks in peer_set.json.

IT_SOFTWARE.source_note: Bank IT spend as % of total income (BSE annual reports, IBA technology survey).

PROF_SERVICES.source_note: Audit, legal, consulting, and rating fees for listed banks.

FACILITIES.source_note: Branch network rent and premises costs.

OUTSOURCED.source_note: BPO, collections, KYC processing outsourced to third parties.

HR.source_note: Employee benefit expense as % of total operating expenses. peer_set staff_cost_to_total_opex_pct; HDFC/ICICI/SBI FY25 disclosures.

CONTINGENT.source_note: Contract tellers, collections agents, IT contractors as % of total opex. NASSCOM BPM and IBA workforce surveys.

FIN_SVCS.source_note: Correspondent banking fees, payment rail charges, treasury transaction costs.

kyc_aml_ops.source_note: KYC/AML operations cost including V-KYC, transaction monitoring, and periodic re-KYC. IBA technology survey 2024.

treasury_ops.source_note: Treasury and ALM operations FTE and system costs excluding SLR/CRR opportunity cost.

npa_provisioning_cost.source_note: NPA provisions and write-offs as % of total opex. Aligns with npa_provision_to_opex KPI; RBI IRACP norms.

cre_credit_risk_infra.source_note: Credit risk infrastructure: CRILC, rating agency fees, bureau queries, risk analytics platforms.

loan_processing_ops.source_note: Loan origination, underwriting, and collections operations cost excluding provisions.

contact_center_ops.source_note: Contact centre and customer service operations including inbound/outbound voice and digital chat.

core_banking_platform.source_note: Core banking system licensing, maintenance, and CBS-related infrastructure as % of opex.

digital_banking_infra.source_note: Mobile banking, internet banking, UPI, and digital channel platform costs.

branch_network_ops.source_note: Branch network operating costs including staff, utilities, and last-mile distribution.

atm_cash_mgmt.source_note: ATM network operations, cash replenishment, and managed services. RBI annual report ATM statistics.

rbi_audit_compliance.source_note: RBI audit, statutory compliance, and regulatory reporting FTE and system costs.
